> A WordPress staging environment is a private copy of your live site for testing changes before they go public.

The workflow is: clone the live site to staging, make and test your changes there, then push to production. One caveat bites stores hard. Pushing the staging database overwrites the live one, so on an active store you push code and files, not the database.

WordPress Staging Environment: Test Before You Break Live

Quick thread 🧵
> A WordPress staging environment is a private copy of your live site for testing changes before they go public.
The workflow is: clone the live site to staging, make and test your changes there, then push to production.
Pushing the staging database overwrites the live one, so on an active store you push code and files, not the database.
